channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 20th Annual Pumpkin Patch (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · public opening (postponed from 10/9 for Isaias) | First City Art Center | No published price. First City Art Center's 20th Annual Pumpkin Patch opens with a Friday Preview Party on October 9, ahead of a Saturday pumpkin sale. The center's own page had not yet posted the current 2026 sale details at last check.

item.title: Arts & Design Society 70th Anniversary Celebration (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · start time not posted | Arts & Design Society of Fort Walton Beach | No published price. The Arts & Design Society of Fort Walton Beach is celebrating its 70th anniversary on Saturday, October 24 at its gallery on First Street. The gallery is open Tuesday through Friday from 12 PM-4 PM and Saturday from 1 PM-4 PM, and visits are free.

item.title: Blackout Bowling at The Gulf Bowl (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 6:00 PM to Saturday 10/24 · 1:00 AM | The Gulf Bowl & Captain's Choice Seafood Bar | from $24. A Halloween bowling package pairs unlimited black-light bowling with two laser tag admissions, a ten dollar arcade card and a costume contest, open to the public. The package runs from Friday evening into the early hours of Saturday.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: CWF Aftershock pro wrestling (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · doors 6:00 PM, bell 7:00 PM | The Hangar 41 | No published price. Coastal Wrestling Federation brings pro wrestling to Fort Walton Beach for the first time with Aftershock, the follow-up to Proving Ground 7. The CWF World and Division 1 titles are on the card. The listing says all ages, with free parking and no refunds.

item.title: Fall Ball at Blue Wahoos Stadium: Florida vs. Troy (fall baseball exhibition) (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · start time not posted | Blue Wahoos Stadium | No published price. Fall Ball: Florida vs. Troy is a college baseball scrimmage at the Blue Wahoos' downtown ballpark on Saturday, October 24. It's one of three fall exhibitions in what the club calls its largest-ever fall schedule. Tickets are sold through bluewahoos.com.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Garden & Gun Society and Friends Gathering at Alys Beach (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Thursday 10/22 to Sunday 10/25 · schedule on the event itinerary | Alys Beach | No published price. Alys Beach hosts the Garden & Gun Society and Friends Gathering from Thursday, October 22 through Sunday, October 25 in partnership with Garden & Gun magazine. The four day event brings together chefs, artisans, designers, musicians, conservationists and storytellers for curated dinners, conversations, architectural tours, outdoor excursions and live music. Tickets and the full itinerary are on the link from Alys Beach's event page.

item.title: Haunted History Walking Tours (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Fri 10/23 and Sat 10/24 · 6:30 PM, 7:30 PM and 8:30 PM | Historic Pensacola Village | from $15. Historic Pensacola runs two after-dark walking tours on four nights in October. The Haunted Village tour visits the Dorr House, Old Christ Church and the Lear/Rocheblave House, and Macabre Museum Mysteries goes through the Arbona Building and the Museum of History. Children 3 and older are welcome.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SAT 10/24)
item.description: During library hours through 11/1 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. It hangs all day during the library's own hours through November 1, so call the library to confirm them before you go.

item.title: Maggot Sandwich at Downtown Music Hall (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · doors 6:00 PM, show 7:00 PM | Downtown Music Hall | from $15. Maggot Sandwich plays Downtown Music Hall with Earl's Killer Squirrels and Dead Devils. The listing marks the show all ages, with $15 advance tickets. The music runs from 7 to about 10 PM.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 10/24)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation 31st Annual Festival of the Arts (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 | Mattie Kelly Dugas Pavilion Green | Free. The Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation's 31st Annual Festival of the Arts is free to attend, including parking, on Saturday, October 24. The exact venue was not confirmed, so check the foundation's own page before heading out. The festival returns every year, now in its 31st edition.

item.title: Mobile Opera: Romeo et Juliette (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 7:30 PM and Sunday 10/25 · 2:30 PM | The Temple Downtown | No published price. Mobile Opera stages Gounod's Romeo et Juliette in French with English supertitles, with a Friday evening show and a Sunday matinee. Mobile County's listing does not publish a ticket price.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Monster Dash 5K & Trunk or Treat (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · Check-in 4:00 PM · 5K start 5:00 PM | Navarre Soccer Complex | from $25. Navarre Youth Sports Association runs a family Halloween 5K with a community trunk-or-treat, costume and decorated-trunk contests, candy, music and food. Registration is $25 through October 3, $30 through October 21, and $35 on race day; a Mini Monster Dash 1K runs alongside it. Proceeds support NYSA youth sports and facilities, and the event runs rain or shine, barring unsafe conditions.

item.title: Monstrous Halloween Bash and Trick-or-Treating (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · trick-or-treating 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Kids Halloween Bash 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM | Rosemary Beach Town Center and East Long Green | Free. Rosemary Beach turns its Town Center into a trick-or-treat route from 10 AM to 5 PM, with kids going shop to shop for treats. The Kids Halloween Bash on the East Long Green from 2 to 5 PM has inflatables, face painting, balloons and carnival-style games with prizes. All ages are welcome and costumes are encouraged.

item.title: More Than Revival weekend (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 7:00 PM · Saturday 10/24 · 6:00 PM · Sunday 10/25 · 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM | Avalon Middle School (hosted by Voyage Church) | from $15. Voyage Church hosts a three-day revival weekend at Avalon Middle School in Milton, with a Friday night kickoff, Saturday and Sunday services, a ministry expo, food trucks and water baptisms on Sunday. Tickets are needed, and the Voyagers children's program covers ages 3 months through 5th grade at every service. Saturday breakout sessions are at Voyage HQ on Mulat Road, where children cannot attend and childcare is not provided.

item.title: Next Stop Comedy at The Prost Office Brewery (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · 7:30 PM seating · show 8:00 PM | The Prost Office Brewery | from $27. Next Stop Comedy brings a touring stand up lineup to The Prost Office Brewery in downtown Milton. Dan Bakst headlines, and the company brings a new lineup to every show. Seating opens at 7:30 PM and the show starts at 8:00 PM.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Parrot Heads in Paradise: Meeting of the Minds (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Wednesday 10/21 to Sunday 10/25 · schedule on motm.rocks | The Hangout, LuLu's and Flora-Bama | No published price. Parrot Head clubs from across the country gather in Gulf Shores for five days of live music, themed nights and Cheeseburger in Paradise menu items. The main stage is at The Hangout, with more events at LuLu's and Flora-Bama. Registration is open to non-members.

item.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Oct 22 – Nov 1 | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds | No published price. Eleven days of rides, livestock barns and fried everything at the fairgrounds off Mobile Highway. The 60% off Super Saver closed on 07/15/2026, and the fair has not posted what replaces it.

item.title: Plantmania Expo 2026 (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Saturday 10/24 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Daphne Civic Center | from $15. Plantmania brings a two-day tropical plant expo to the Daphne Civic Center, with live workshops, free classes, plant care and propagation demonstrations and a marketplace of plant vendors and makers. General entry is $15 and children 12 and under get in free. Classes come with entry, while the Kokedama, Terrarium and Staghorn Fern workshops cost extra.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Prodisee Pantry Turkey Trot 5K and Fun Run (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · 5K 8:00 AM, fun run 9:00 AM | Daphne City Hall | No published price. Prodisee Pantry's Turkey Trot runs a 5K and a 1 mile fun run on a certified downtown Daphne course, with a family festival at City Hall. The 5K starts at 8 AM and the fun run at 9 AM. Proceeds pay for holiday meals for Baldwin County families.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Rocky Homicide Murder Mystery Dinner Theatre (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Fri 10/23 & Sat 10/24/2026 · Doors 6:00 PM · Show 7:00 PM · also 10/29-10/30 | Heritage Hall at Seville Quarter | from $69. This boxing-gym whodunit downtown is the longest run of the series, four nights across two weekends. It includes dinner, a cast working the room, and clues between courses.

item.title: Shinedown's Lunatic Ball Beach Weekend (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Friday 10/23 | Seascape Resort | No published price. Shinedown's Lunatic Ball Beach Weekend brings a multi-day music getaway to Seascape Resort starting Friday, October 23. No start time or address is posted for the weekend yet. The resort's own event page carries them first.

item.title: South Walton Celebrity Golf Classic (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Thu 10/22 · 5:30 PM opening · Fri 10/23 · 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM · Sat 10/24 · 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Raven Golf Club / Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. The South Walton Celebrity Golf Classic returns to Raven Golf Club at Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort on Thursday, October 22, running from 8:30 AM to 6 PM. The multiday fundraiser supports the Emerald Coast Children's Advocacy Center and combines golf programming with receptions across the event. It repeats annually, and these are its opening days.

item.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Fri 10/23 to Sun 11/1 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:30 PM | Pensacola State College, Ashmore Auditorium, Building 8 | No published price. Pensacola State College stages Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street in Ashmore Auditorium over two weekends, October 23 to 25 and October 30 to November 1. The college describes the eight-time Tony Award winning musical as a thriller about an exiled barber who seeks revenge on a corrupt system of justice. One performance falls on Halloween night.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: Video Game Day (Century Library) (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · all day | Century Library | No published price. Video Game Day at Century Library is a chance to play video games on the library's big screen. The first one is Saturday, October 10, listed as all day, and a second Video Game Day is on October 24.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Wig Walk 2026 for Prism United (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · check-in 3:30 PM, walk 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM, after-party 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM | Downtown Mobile, starting at Braided River Brewing Co. | No published price. The fourth Wig Walk raises money so Prism United can keep its programs free for LGBTQ+ young people. Walkers visit 12 downtown Mobile venues for brews, bubbles and bite-sized samples, and the walk itself is 21 and over, with alcohol-free options along the route. The after-party at Braided River Brewing from 7 PM is open to all ages.

item.title: Heroes on the Water kayak fishing day (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Archie Glover Boat Ramp | Free. The Emerald Coast chapter of Heroes on the Water runs a morning of kayaking and kayak fishing at no cost for veterans, active duty, first responders and their families. The chapter brings the kayaks, fishing gear and safety equipment, and lunch is provided. Chapter events are open only to veterans, first responders and their family members.

item.title: Fall Market in the Park (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturdays 10/17 to 11/14 · 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM | Cathedral Square | No published price. The City of Mobile runs Fall Market in the Park every Saturday morning from October 17 through November 14 in Cathedral Square. Farmers, artisans and food vendors sell seasonal produce, seafood, baked goods and art, and live entertainment plays in the park while you shop. Vendors accept Senior Farmer's Market Nutritional Program benefits, and leashed pets are welcome.

item.title: Navarre Beach Park and Big Sabine Point bird walk (SAT 10/24)
item.description: Saturday 10/24 · meet at 7:30 AM | Sandpiper Pavilion, Navarre Beach Park | Free. Choctawhatchee Audubon Society's Jim Anderton leads a Saturday morning walk looking for shorebirds, rails and migrating species. The group birds Navarre Beach Park for about an hour, then drives together to the east lot of Pensacola Beach Park to search Big Sabine Point. The second part is optional and includes a dune hike and maybe wet ground.
